Old instance_rules intentionally guards if protocol and skips protocol-specific builders, allowing group-source IP expansion without a protocol selector. After unconditionally calls rule.protocol.lower(), so this previously supported rule fails before source expansion/fallback instead of generating the old all-protocol rule. This is an introduced null-state regression, not arbitrary malformed DB input. Separately IPv6 lowercase ICMP is renamed icmpv6 before the later branch tests protocol==icmp, so type/code building is skipped in both versions. That is a residual old ICMPv6 restriction failure, not introduction by normalization or proof that this patch fully repairs every protocol case.
additional_after_concerns: Residual IPv6 ICMP type/code omission remains because translation to icmpv6 precedes a later comparison with icmp. This is present in both before and after; do not label it introduced or use the normalization patch as a complete all-protocol firewall negative.
